{{Top|leg}}
'''Killsat''' was a method of curtailing space-based scouting by disabling [[Satellite/Legends|satellites]] used to give precise information to ground commanders. It was used by both the [[Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to gain an advantage on each other in battle.<ref name="RASB">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref>
